ref_extractions.title: Analysis and Visualization of Single-Trial Event-Related Potentials
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: This paper describes ICA methods for single-trial ERP analysis and artifact removal but uses a different visual selective attention dataset (28 controls + 22 patients). It does not reference or use openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Phase Lag Index: Assessment of Functional Connectivity From Multi Channel EEG and MEG
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Methodology paper introducing Phase Lag Index for connectivity analysis. Uses absence seizure EEG and Alzheimer's patient data for validation. Does not use openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: A Statistical Framework for Neuroimaging Data Analysis Based on Mutual Information Estimated via a Gaussian Copula
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Methods paper presenting a copula-based mutual information estimator for neuroimaging. Demonstrates on MEG planar gradients and evoked EEG responses but does not reference openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Deep Learning in Mining Biological Data
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Meta-analysis review of deep learning applications across biological data types including EEG. General survey paper without application to or mention of openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: A high-density scalp EEG dataset acquired during brief naps after a visual working memory task
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Data descriptor for a different EEG dataset (nap EEG after working memory) with 22 subjects, 64 channels at 1kHz. OSF repository. Completely different paradigm and setup from openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Evidence of an inhibitory restraint of seizure activity in humans
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Study on seizure activity using microelectrode arrays in epilepsy patients. Intracranial recordings, not scalp EEG. Does not use openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Multimodal EEG–fNIRS classification as a clinical tool for bipolar disorder diagnosis
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Bipolar disorder diagnosis study using EEG+fNIRS with emotional visual task. Different clinical paradigm, different subjects. Does not use openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Decoding real-world visual scenes from alpha and gamma band flicker evoked oscillations in human EEG
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: SSVEP study with LCD flicker glasses decoding visual scenes. Different experimental setup with custom flicker paradigm. Does not reference openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Near-invisible c-VEP-based passive BCI for mental workload monitoring
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: c-VEP BCI study for workload monitoring in flight simulator. Uses custom StAR stimuli paradigm. Does not use openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Exploration of using distance-to-bound to manipulate the difficulty during motor imagery BCI training after stroke
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Motor imagery BCI rehabilitation study with stroke patients. Uses MI paradigm with hand movements. Does not use openneuro_ds006547 visual stimulation dataset.

ref_extractions.title: EEG dataset and OpenBMI toolbox for three BCI paradigms: an investigation into BCI illiteracy
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Describes OpenBMI BCI dataset with MI, ERP, SSVEP paradigms from 54 subjects. Different dataset entirely, not openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Explaining Deep Neural Networks and Beyond: A Review of Methods and Applications
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Review paper on explainable AI methods. General methodology review without specific dataset applications. Does not use openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: EEG-Based Emotion Recognition Using Regularized Graph Neural Networks
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Emotion recognition study using SEED and SEED-IV datasets. Different paradigm (emotional video clips), different datasets. Does not use openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs): A Survey of Recent Studies on Signal Sensing Technologies and Computational Intelligence Approaches
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Survey paper on EEG-based BCI technologies and machine learning. General review without application to openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Deep Learning for Electromyographic Hand Gesture Signal Classification Using Transfer Learning
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: EMG-based gesture recognition using Myo armband and NinaPro database. EMG modality, different physiological signal entirely. Does not use openneuro_ds006547 EEG dataset.

ref_extractions.title: Best practices for fNIRS publications
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Guidelines paper for fNIRS methodology reporting. Different neuroimaging modality (fNIRS), not EEG. Does not use openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Automatic Classification of Artifactual ICA-Components for Artifact Removal in EEG Signals
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Methods paper on automated ICA artifact classification for EEG. Uses reaction time, auditory ERP, and motor imagery BCI data for validation - different paradigms entirely.

ref_extractions.title: Independent EEG Sources Are Dipolar
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Comparison of ICA/BSS algorithms on 13 datasets with visual working memory task. Uses SCCN BSS comparison dataset, not openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Functionally Independent Components of the Late Positive Event-Related Potential during Visual Spatial Attention
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: ICA decomposition of LPC components in visual selective attention task with 10 subjects. Different dataset from SCCN with different electrode setup. Does not use openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: The Spatiotemporal Dynamics of Illusory Contour Processing: Combined High-Density Electrical Mapping, Source Analysis, and Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Illusory contour study combining EEG, ERP, VEP, and fMRI. Different experimental paradigm (Kanizsa stimuli), 28 subjects. Does not use openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Age-Related Changes in 1/f Neural Electrophysiological Noise
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Aging study using ECoG (intracranial) and scalp EEG comparing young vs older adults. Uses different resting-state paradigm. Does not use openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Artificial neural networks in medical diagnosis
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Review paper on ANN applications in medical diagnosis. General overview without specific dataset. Does not use openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Review of the BCI competition IV
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Review of BCI competition IV challenges and datasets. Describes motor imagery, ERP, SSVEP paradigms from competition. Does not use openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Software paper describing MNE-Python capabilities. Mentions sample datasets but does not specifically use openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: The Harvard Automated Processing Pipeline for Electroencephalography (HAPPE)
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Pipeline paper for automated EEG processing. Validates on developmental EEG datasets with EGI system. Does not use openneuro_ds006547 BrainVision dataset.

ref_extractions.title: A Tutorial Review of Functional Connectivity Analysis Methods and Their Interpretational Pitfalls
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Tutorial on functional connectivity methods (coherence, PLV, Granger causality). Uses simulated data and generic EEG examples. Does not use openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Physiologically Guided Modeling for EEG Multichannel Signals
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Methods paper proposing FMM dipole model for EEG. Validates on unspecified publicly available EEG data. Does not reference openneuro_ds006547.

ref_extractions.title: Deep Learning-Based Alzheimer's Disease Detection from Multi-Channel EEG Using Fused Time-Frequency Image Grids
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Alzheimer's detection study using resting-state EEG with dementia patients. Different clinical paradigm, different dataset. Does not use openneuro_ds006547 visual stimulation dataset.

ref_extractions.title: High-resolution EEG dataset during resting and localized visual stimulation in the lower-left visual field
ref_extractions.cot_reasoning: Data descriptor for high-resolution EEG (10kHz) with checkerboard visual stimulation from 8 subjects at RIKEN. Different setup (64-channel, DC mode, 10kHz vs 67-channel 500Hz), different stimulus paradigm. Does not use openneuro_ds006547.

feasibility_reason: The dataset has a clear visual stimulation paradigm with 30 distinct, balanced stimulus condition labels and well-documented event structure across 31 subjects. Although no relevant references were found, OpenNeuro ds006547 is a well-known public dataset with a concrete 30-class visual condition classification task defined in the analysis.md.

### Potential Task 2: Visual Evoked Potential (Extended Window)
- **Task Type**: classification
- **Epoch Method**: `epoch_by_event_hdf5`
- **Epoch Parameters**: tmin = -0.5 s, tmax = 1.5 s, baseline = (-0.5, -0.05), target_events = see Target Definition
- **Label Route**: `event`
- **Meta Level**: raw
- **Target Definition**: Same event-to-label mapping as Task 1
- **Evidence (DOI)**: None (plausible from paradigm alone)
- **Kernel Notes**: Extended window captures later cognitive components (P300, sustained potentials). Longer baseline (-0.5s) improves drift correction. Appropriate for studying attention/perception differences across multi-condition visual paradigm.
